concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-dispute-search-node]] - Braintree Node.js dispute search with callback `response.forEach()` result access, raw routes for criteria and operators, Control Panel access qualification, and the preserved results-limitation notice
warnings: Retain the PayPal Data Protection Addendum notice without interpreting the unread external policy or specifying which results or fields are limited.
Keep API availability qualified to merchants who can access disputes in the Braintree Control Panel.
Keep this source scoped to dispute search and callback result iteration; do not generalize it to single-dispute lookup, acceptance, evidence submission, or finalization.

Treat the linked Search fields and Dispute response pages as navigation only; this source does not establish their unread full operator inventory, response schema, pagination, or broader availability behavior.
